"Pull down from the blue or cyan top bar to refresh the portfolio.

Swipe a search result from left to right to add it to favorites. Swipe a portfolio row from right to left to remove it. Tap a portfolio row for details.

1 D: change from the previous trading day close.
1 W / 1 M: change from the available closing price one week / calendar month earlier.
YTD: change from the last available closing price of the previous year.

Changes use the trading currency and exclude added dividends. Fund values may be delayed. Yahoo is an unofficial data source. Coverage and availability vary. Favorites are stored on the device.

Hold a row, then drag up or down to reorder favorites.

3 Y / 5 Y: cumulative price change over three / five calendar years, without annualisation. Missing comparison history is shown as a dash.

Dividend yield (12 mo): gross dividends in the last 12 calendar months divided by the current price. Yahoo ex-dividend dates determine the period. This is historical yield, not a forecast or a personal after-tax return. Indices and missing or insufficient dividend data show a dash. Refresh after updating to fetch dividend data."
"Added German and English alongside Finnish.\nThe app follows the phone language. Other languages default to English."

"Pull down to refresh.
Swipe to add and remove favorites.
Removed the refresh button and star icons.
Added Development Maukka and a three-version changelog.
Moved Yahoo Finance below the Info button."

"One row per security.
Added YTD change.
Cyan column headers stay at the top.
Tap a row to view details."
"Rows now follow the finger during a swipe.\nGreen Add and red Remove actions are revealed behind the row.\nIncomplete swipes animate back into place."
"Added the last successful refresh date and time to the bottom bar.\nA rotating dollar sign indicates a refresh in progress.\nYahoo Finance is now shown only inside Info."
"Added favorite reordering by long press and vertical drag.\nThe new order is saved on the device.\nAn insertion marker and edge scrolling help place the row."
"Replaced the interface font with the VT323 pixel font.\nPixel lettering also covers search, dialogs, swipe labels and the dollar indicator.\nFinnish and German special characters are supported."
"Increased the portfolio row and column header font from 12 to 15 sp (+25%).\nRemoved automatic shrinking of table text.\nLong security names use an ellipsis; each security stays on one row."
"Added 3-year and 5-year percentage changes to security details.\nExtended the price history used for comparisons.\nMissing comparison data is shown as a dash."
"Added indices to Search and Portfolio.\nSearch S&P 500, Nasdaq Composite, Nasdaq-100 and OMX Helsinki PI by name.\nIndex levels are displayed in points."
"Added a separate trailing 12-month dividend yield to security details.\nPrice changes remain separate.\nMissing dividend data is displayed as a dash."
"Moved the rotating dollar refresh indicator to the top of the list.\nCentred the rotation axis on the visible dollar glyph.\nIncreased the dollar size by 50%."
"Set the rotating dollar refresh indicator opacity to 80%."
"Restricted pull-to-refresh to gestures starting on the blue or cyan top bar. Portfolio row gestures no longer trigger refresh."
